title: Medical Disclaimer & App Purpose
subtitle: Essential clinical and legal notice for UC Tracker
purposeText: UC Tracker is a digital tool designed solely for personal self-monitoring of daily habits, symptoms, and medication adherence for individuals diagnosed with Ulcerative Colitis (UC) and Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD).
noSubstituteText: Calculations (Partial Mayo Score, Bristol Stool Scale) and educational guidance DO NOT constitute a medical diagnosis, clinical prescription, or treatment plan. NEVER start, modify, or stop any medications (biologics, steroids, immunosuppressants, or mesalamine) without explicit guidance from your gastroenterologist.
errorsText: Algorithmic estimates are statistical self-care references and may contain technical limitations or diverge from your individual clinical course. This application serves to support your communication with your healthcare team.
emergencyText: If you experience massive rectal bleeding with clots, high persistent fever (> 38.5°C), excruciating abdominal pain with distension, or fainting/severe dizziness, DO NOT wait: seek IMMEDIATE emergency hospital care.
